body: 16 years ago, 50 Cent linked up with Keenan Cahill to lip-sync Jeremih’s “Down On Me” It started like one of Keenan’s usual webcam videos, then 50 Cent stepped into the frame and joined in. Seeing 50 show up in the middle of a bedroom lip-sync was the kind of surprise that made you send the video to everybody you knew. If you grew up watching Keenan, this clip takes you right back to those early YouTube days. Rest in peace, Keenan. Thanks for all the laughs and memories.
